section_label: Table 4 - Bond Lengths and Angles, Modification II

analytics.raw_text: Table 4 (printed Tabelle 4) gives the bond lengths in [Angstrom] and bond angles of crystal modification II from the single-crystal structure analysis: 89 rows, 35 bond lengths from 1.220 to 1.7843 Angstrom and 54 bond angles from 30.21 to 123.42 degrees. Lines 355 to 471. The full list is in the source.

notes: Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S: identical atoms and bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice. It is not a distinct chemical entity, it is crystal modification II of tembotrione. Table 4 is analytical data on one refined structure. The labels in the bond column (printed Bindung) are atoms of this one molecule, not compounds. The A and B suffixes, on O(3), C(9), C(10) and F(1) to F(3), mark two alternative refined positions of the disordered trifluoroethoxymethyl group within the same molecule, which is why the table carries a value for the angle O(3A)-C(8)-O(3B) between two alternative positions of one oxygen. Referenced from paragraph [0014]. Unlike Table 3, this caption prints no [degrees] unit after the word for bond angles (Bindungswinkel); recorded as printed.
